_metadata.purpose: Slack app manifest for triage-bot. Paste at https://api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From manifest. This ONE app serves: (1) Grafana alerting delivery via Incoming Webhooks, (2) the triage bot's send identity (chat:write/im:write, used by scripts/slack_send.py). The async Events API trigger is PARKED — see slack-receiver/README.md to revive it later.
after_install: OAuth & Permissions -> copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...) -> put in .env as SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
Incoming Webhooks -> Add New Webhook to Workspace -> #triage-bot-health -> copy URL -> .env TRIAGE_BOT_HEALTH_WEBHOOK (one webhook per team channel later)
Invite @triage-bot to #triage-bot-health and the 3 public alert channels (alert-system, alert-frontend-errors, alert-runtime-monitoring). Do NOT invite to #swat or #team-incident-response.
Verify sending: python scripts/slack_send.py heartbeat --text "triage-bot app online"
Fill any new channel IDs into kb/config.json
(Parked) async trigger: add the event_subscriptions block from README + deploy the Cloudflare worker.
